item.title: Mach Five Tech Launches Patent Badge and PCX Platform to Transform Patent Licensing and Monetization
item.description: × Intellectual Property Innovation Platform For Immediate Release Chicago IL • April 5, 2025 — Mach Five Tech today announced the launch of Patent Badge and PCX (Patent License Option Contract Exchange), a groundbreaking platform that transforms how patents are authenticated, valued, and licensed in the global marketplace. The platform addresses a critical gap in the intellectual property ecosystem by providing patent holders with transparent valuation tools and a neutral marketplace for licensing opportunities, while offering corporations and legal professionals streamlined access to authenticated patent licenses.
